summary: Operationalise MITRE ATT&CK, CTI platforms, and SIEM/SOAR workflows. Build practical analysis and detection skills. Explore the 5-day course.
lede: Cyber threat intelligence training helps SOC analysts, CTI analysts, detection engineers and security leaders turn adversary information into defensive decisions. Participants practise evaluating source reliability, mapping adversary tactics and techniques, and translating findings into threat-hunt hypotheses and SIEM/SOAR use cases. Exercises also cover intelligence requirements, platform workflows, and technical and executive reporting to connect analysis with detection priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for security professionals who produce, analyse, or operationalise cyber threat intelligence across SOC, detection, and security leadership workflows.
modules: CTI Feeds in SIEM and SOAR
prerequisites: Working knowledge of SOC operations, common security alerts, and basic threat terminology is recommended. No programming is required; exercises focus on analysis, mapping, and workflow design.
